look_ahead.decision_instant: D = scheduled end (occurrence) minus 120, 60 or 30 minutes; the clock check drops any game whose occurrence is not one value on :00 or :30
look_ahead.features: each feature uses candles ending at or before D only; the candle job windows start at D - 30 min
look_ahead.entry_quote: the latest two-sided candle ending in [D - 180 s, D]
look_ahead.exit: H settles on the list's result, read last for traded rungs; M10 sells at the mark ending 10 minutes before the scheduled end

event.entry_rule: every rung open at D whose side ask is in the cell's band and passes the cell's filter, one contract set per rung

gates.unit: game (z and the BH p from game-level sums; n stated in games first)

prediction: best of 624 cells reaches PF 1.15 to 1.30 by luck on 16 days; P(a rule clears every gate on development and holds on the joint read) about 4%
kill: no rule with 48 or more trades and PF 1.3 or more at 1c with both halves 1.0 or more; or nothing survives BH
subset_rationale: the grid values were fixed from round numbers and the feature definitions before any price of these markets was read; 3 x 4 x 2 x 2 x 13 = 624
fee_form: ceil(round(0.07 x n x p x (1 - p) x 100, 9)) / 100 per order; a void refunds the price and keeps the fee
n_floor: no evidence at n = x below 100
